name: Intake record guard: page a human when an AI intake agent logs an emergency nobody can act on

parameters.content:
## Intake record guard

Your AI intake agent (voice, SMS or web form) posts its JSON record here. This workflow checks it before anything else does.

- **Emergency with no callback number or address** → pages a human immediately. This is the one that matters: an escalation nobody can act on.
- **Any other emergency** → pages a human with the address and callback number.
- **Missing or placeholder fields** ("unknown", "123 Main St", "555-555-5555") → flags for review.
- **Everything** → continues to your CRM or sheet.

Why this exists: https://dev.to/rizkynandapr/8-of-my-ai-agents-30-test-calls-failed-every-one-was-my-fault-3kff

### Setup (2 minutes)
1. Open **Alert on-call** and paste a Slack incoming webhook URL. (Discord: rename `text` to `content` in the body.)
2. Replace **Send to your CRM or sheet** with your real destination.
3. Activate, then POST a test record to the webhook URL (see the note on the right).

## Test it

POST this to the webhook's test URL. It is the exact record from the article, and it should page you:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "trade": "hvac",
  "urgency": "emergency",
  "emergency_type": "gas",
  "callback_number": null,
  "service_address": {"street": null, "city": null, "postal_code": null},
  "problem_summary": "Caller said the furnace isn't working and it smells like eggs downstairs.",
  "outcome": "escalated"
}
```

The webhook replies with `severity` (`page`, `review` or `ok`) and the list of problems, so your agent's platform can log it too.
